marta: Morning — small update: due to infra maintenance in us-east the release train needs to be compacted by 30m. Proposed new slot: 2026-03-18 10:30–11:00 PT (was 11:00–11:30). Deploys in this slot:
- service-a v2 (db migrations included)
- embeddings-proxy 1.4.2
- runtime-optimizer hotfix
Can people confirm ownership for deploy + smoke + rollback? I want explicit names for each.

jon: I can take service-a deploy and smoke. I'll be available 10:15–12:00. For rollback I'll be on-call.

liam: embeddings-proxy is me. smoke window ok. Quick note: config change needs new secret; I'll push after smoke. Rollback owner: liam.

sasha: runtime-optimizer still needs a quick perf test, can we run perf on staging by 09:30? If it looks good i'll do the deploy and smoke 10:30.

kyra: I can shadow runtime-optimizer rollback and stand by during smoke.

eng-release-bot: schedule-update: release-train-slot 3377659999 updated -> start 10:30 PT, watchers: @marta @jon @liam @sasha @kyra :calendar:

marta: thanks all. sasha please post perf result (pass/fail) by 09:35. jon/liam confirm you have rollback playbooks attached here:
```
rollback steps:
1. disable new pods
2. revert config on configstore
3. restore DB migration if needed
4. restart svc
```

jon: rollback playbook linked. :thumbsup:

liam: linked too. passing the secret handoff to ops for PRD write.

sasha: perf looks good on staging, 95th latency matches baseline. go-ahead from me.

marta: perfect — locking slot. If anything changes ping here. :rocket:
